description:
A curious and enlightening wander through the City of London led by an expert guide. If you know where to look, the past still communicates its secrets concealed within a city that is 2000 years old.

We'll discover clues to the City’s past in strange marks and curious symbols along the route, keeping an eye out for honeybees, demi-maidens and sunbursts.

factsheet.heading: A curious wander through the City of London
paragraphs: On this entertaining, enlightening, and fascinating tour, follow your expert guide. If you know where to look, the past still communicates its secrets concealed within a city that is two-thousand years old.
Ever wonder why we say ‘at sixes and sevens?
What are those badges on the lamps outside the Royal Exchange?
Why are there no roads in the City of London?

Yet these streets have such curious names: Love Lane anybody? We'll discover clues to the City’s past in strange marks and curious symbols along the environs of Cheapside (why Cheap?), keeping an eye out for honeybees, demi -maidens and sunbursts. And so much more.
Please note: children must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
